series extended rather than kept as a continuation or companion: same worldwide scope and formulation as the 2021Q2-2025Q4 rows
notes: Worldwide reported net sales of Wegovy injectable (formulation 'injection (pen)'). Up to 2025Q4 Novo Nordisk prints one 'Wegovy' row; the oral Wegovy pill was approved by the US FDA on 22 December 2025 and launched on 5 January 2026 (Q4 2025 report, caq42025.htm), so no pill sales are in the 'Wegovy' rows and the line is injectable only. From the Q1 2026 report the row is labelled 'Wegovy injectable' and the pill is printed as its own row ('Wegovy pill': 2,256 in Q1 2026, 3,218 in Q2 2026), which is excluded from this series; the 2026 rows are the same product and scope, not a narrower line. Reported sales are recorded throughout; 2026Q1 reported sales (20,513) include a one-off 340B provision reversal of DKK 2,278 million (adjusted sales 18,235); 2026Q2 reported and adjusted are both 19,484. Supersedes the companion series novo_wegovy_injectable (same two 2026 rows), which should be retired when this is promoted.
